name: Ice Cream Sandwich Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Ice Cream Sandwich is an indica dominant hybrid strain with a creamy and floral aroma and flavor profile. This strain brings sweet vanilla and coconut aromas that evoke a rich creamy taste — while also pairing with peppery, lavender and citrus notes that blend together for an earthy floral deliciousness. Ice Cream Sandwich will provide uplifting effects that will carry you into a serene state. Its dominant terpenes include Limonene, ß-caryophyllene, and Linalool.
